title: Firbolg
summary: Firbolg the Fierce Giant was one of the guardian Titans of the magical floating castle of Tír na nÓg alongside Dullahan the headless knight. His Amulet is currently in the possession of Scarlet Byrne.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Fir Bolg, or "bag men" were one of the first of the legendary races of Celtic mythology. Some legends say that the Firbolg were enslaved, either by the other Celtic groups, or by the Greeks. [Wikipedia:Fir Bolg]

Firbolg and Dullahan Titans stood as guardians of Tír na nÓg where they attacked Scarlet Byrne, Den Fears, Sophie Casterwill and Dante Vale, and fought against Powerbonded Sabriel and Kaioh the Tracker. Despite overpowering the team, Firbolg was defeated when Lok Lambert returned from the Inter-dimensional World and invoked Pendragon, the Legendary Titan of Champions. His Amulet was then obtained by Scarlet. [Back Home]

In the final battle against the Blood Spiral, Firbolg saved Fenris from a Marauder Titan. This impressed Montehue lost for words as he has been telling Scarlet how powerful Fenris was. [Lok and the Betrayer]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Firbold is a large and very strong titan. He can pick up smaller titans with ease and can crush them in his hands. Firbolg once picked up a [[Marauder]] and squeezed it so hard it returned to its amulet. This strength, coupled with his large size, make Firbolg a very powerful Titan. {{source|Lok and the Betrayer}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*Firbolg is based on the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fir_Bolg Fir Bolg], one of the peoples who lived in Ireland before the arrival of the ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tuatha_D%C3%A9_Danann Tuatha Dé Danann]'', the gods of the Gaelic Celts. 
*Despite his design being based in Celtic lore like that of the [[Gaia-Titans]], Firbolg is a [[Meso-Titan]], powerful and challenging to control.
*Firbolg's attack and defense stats were only revealed by the [[Holotome]] in the French dub, with all other dubs giving just his type, size and special abilities - this was likely due to runtime. This is also the case for [[Dullahan]].
